evidence: Touches src/node/mempool_args.cpp and test/functional/mempool_cluster.py to disallow negating cluster limits and validate minimum limits at startup.
rationale: Validates cluster limits at startup to fix an issue where "-nolimitclustercount passed the upper bound check and triggered an assertion in TxGraph when mempool sanity checks are enabled" and "-limitclustersize=0 or -nolimitclustersize made every transaction fail with a misleading error".
